text:
emily-cs: Customer reports they cannot activate the promo trial. UI shows 'Payment method required' even though promo NEW2026 should allow a free trial. They see a 3DS modal that never completes (spinning), then our UI surfaces PAYMENT_REQUIRED / card_required_for_trial. Account: acct_01GabcXYZ. Tried on Chrome macOS.
omar-payments: Can you paste the raw gateway error and exact timestamps? Was a PaymentIntent or SetupIntent created? Also, do we have the Stripe charge id?

emily-cs: From our platform logs: 
> 2026-03-15T14:22:41Z ERROR payments/pipeline.go:201 "3DS challenge timeout" account=acct_01GabcXYZ method=card last4=4242 gateway=stripe pi=pi_3JkXxx status=requires_action error="issuer_timeout"

Also customer pasted this UI error: "Card required to start trial." They don't want to share full PAN.

jen-eng: Repro steps I used in staging:
1) Create account + apply promo NEW2026
2) UI triggers create PaymentIntent with amount=0 & setup_future_usage=off (we currently create a zero-amount PI to attach card)
3) Stripe responds requires_action with next_action.type=use_stripe_sdk -> frontend opens 3DS iframe
4) Issuer endpoint returns 504 after ~20s, Stripe moves PI to requires_payment_method and we treat that as failure and block trial.

curl to simulate (do not run with real PAN):
```
curl -X POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/payment_intents
  -u sk_live_xxx:
  -d amount=0
  -d currency=usd
  -d "payment_method_types[]"=card
  -d metadata[account]=acct_01GabcXYZ
```

omar-payments: That matches a class of issuer-timeout failures we've seen. Two immediate options:
- Short-term: customer support can manually grant promo credits so the customer can start using product (admin audit required).
- Medium-term: change our flow to use a SetupIntent for card-on-file (setup_future_usage=off vs 'on_session' matters) so we don't create a 0-amount confirm that triggers 3DS in some issuers. Also consider increasing our 3DS iframe timeout and treating issuer timeouts as soft-fail (allow trial) for verified promos.

mike-finops: Manual grant process OK — please include the ticket id and reason. I confirm finance/audit requires: admin_grant POST payload with account, promo_code, amount_credits, approver, and linked support ticket. We will reconcile at month end.

payment-bot: Incident created #payments-3ds-hang-1840004523 (sev-low, owner=@omar-payments)

emily-cs: I performed a manual grant: POST /admin/grants {account: acct_01GabcXYZ, promo: NEW2026, credits: 1000, reason: '3DS issuer timeout blocked trial', approver: emily-cs}. Customer notified that trial has been applied and to retry.

jen-eng: I'll put a small fix PR to try SetupIntent flow in staging and add a config flag to treat issuer timeouts as non-blocking for promo flows. PR & test plan incoming.

omar-payments: For visibility, adding these logs to the payments dashboard: gateway=stripe issuer_timeout count++ and alert if >5 occurrences/hour for same issuer bin.

emily-cs: Thanks everyone — keeping this open until we see stable staging results. Customer responded: "Thanks, trial started after your manual fix — please keep me posted." :white_check_mark:
